title: Qihuang Zhuyu Formula Attenuates Atherosclerosis via Targeting PPARgamma to Regulate Cholesterol Efflux and Endothelial Cell Inflammation.
authors: Wang, Mengxi; Xiang, Qian; Sun, Weixin; Zhang, Haowen; Shi, Ruijie; Guo, Jun; Tong, Huaqin; Fan, Manlu; Ding, Yuhan; Shi, Haibo; Yu, Peng; Shen, Le; Wang, Qiong; Chen, Xiaohu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过PPARgamma通路抗动脉粥样硬化，仅用分子对接预测药物-靶点结合，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: At present, due to the limitations of drug therapy targets for atherosclerosis, some patients fail to achieve satisfactory efficacy. Cholesterol efflux dysfunction and endothelial cell inflammation are considered to be important factors in the development of atherosclerosis. Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma), a promising therapeutic target for atherosclerosis, plays a dual role in regulating cholesterol efflux and endothelial cell inflammation. However, the use of PPARgamma agonist in clinical practice is greatly limited as it could lead to water and sodium retention and hence result in congestive heart failure. Qihuang Zhuyu Formula (QHZYF) is a hospital preparation of Jiangsu Province Hospital of Chinese Medicine which has definite effect in the treatment of atherosclerosis, but its pharmacological mechanism has not been clear. In this study, we successfully predicted that QHZYF might regulate cholesterol efflux and endothelial inflammation via targeting PPARgamma-mediated PPARgamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1-ABCG1 and PPARgamma/NF-kappaB p65 pathways by using UPLC-Q-TOF/MS, network pharmacology, bioinformatics analysis, and molecular docking technology. Subsequently, we confirmed in vivo that QHZYF could attenuate atherosclerosis in ApoE(-/-) mice and regulate the expression levels of related molecules in PPARgamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1-ABCG1 and PPARgamma/NF-kappaB p65 pathways of ApoE(-/-) mice and C57BL/6 wild-type mice. Finally, in in vitro experiments, we found that QHZYF could reduce lipid content and increase cholesterol efflux rate of RAW 264.7 cells, inhibit the inflammatory response of HUVECs, and regulate the expression levels of related molecules in the two pathways. In addition, the above effects of QHZYF were significantly weakened after PPARgamma knockdown in the two kinds of cells. In conclusion, our study revealed that QHZYF attenuates atherosclerosis via targeting PPARgamma-mediated PPARgamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1-ABCG1 and PPARgamma/NF-kappaB p65 pathways to regulate cholesterol efflux and endothelial cell inflammation. More importantly, our study offers a promising complementary and alternative therapy which is expected to make up for the limitation of current drug treatment methods and provide a valuable reference for new drugs development in the future.
abstract_zh: 目前，由于动脉粥样硬化药物治疗靶点的局限性，部分患者未能获得满意的疗效。胆固醇外流功能障碍和内皮细胞炎症被认为是动脉粥样硬化发展的重要因素。过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma），作为动脉粥样硬化的一个有前景的治疗靶点，在调节胆固醇外流和内皮细胞炎症中发挥双重作用。然而，PPARgamma激动剂在临床上的应用受到很大限制，因为它可能导致水钠潴留，进而引发充血性心力衰竭。芪黄逐瘀方（QHZYF）是江苏省中医院的院内制剂，对动脉粥样硬化具有确切疗效，但其药理机制尚不明确。在本研究中，我们通过UPLC-Q-TOF/MS、网络药理学、生物信息学分析和分子对接技术，成功预测QHZYF可能通过靶向PPARgamma介导的PPARgamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1-ABCG1和PPARgamma/NF-kappaB p65通路来调节胆固醇外流和内皮炎症。随后，我们在体内实验中证实，QHZYF能够减轻ApoE(-/-)小鼠的动脉粥样硬化，并调节ApoE(-/-)小鼠和C57BL/6野生型小鼠中PPARgamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1-ABCG1和PPARgamma/NF-kappaB p65通路相关分子的表达水平。最后，在体外实验中，我们发现QHZYF能降低RAW 264.7细胞的脂质含量并提高胆固醇外流率，抑制HUVECs的炎症反应，并调节这两条通路中相关分子的表达水平。此外，在两种细胞中敲低PPARgamma后，QHZYF的上述效应显著减弱。总之，我们的研究揭示了QHZYF通过靶向PPARgamma介导的PPARgamma/LXRalpha/ABCA1-ABCG1和PPARgamma/NF-kappaB p65通路来调节胆固醇外流和内皮细胞炎症，从而减轻动脉粥样硬化。更重要的是，我们的研究提供了一种有前景的补充和替代疗法，有望弥补当前药物治疗方法的局限性，并为未来新药开发提供有价值的参考。
